name: cntlm
summary: An NTLM, NTLM2SR, and NTLMv2 authenticating HTTP proxy.
highlights: -A — <address>[/<net>] ACL allow rule. IP or hostname, net must be a number (CIDR notation)
-a — ntlm | nt | lm | gss Authentication type - combined NTLM, just LM, just NT, or GSS. Defaul
-c — <config_file> Configuration file. Other arguments can be used as well, overriding config f
-D — <address>[/<net>] ACL deny rule. Syntax same as -A.
-f — Run in foreground, do not fork into daemon mode.

flags.name: -A
flags.description: <address>[/<net>] ACL allow rule. IP or hostname, net must be a number (CIDR notation)

flags.name: -a
flags.description: ntlm | nt | lm | gss Authentication type - combined NTLM, just LM, just NT, or GSS. Default NTLM. GSS activates kerberos auth: you need a cached credential. NTLM is the most versatile setting and likely to work for you.

flags.name: -B
flags.description: Enable NTLM-to-basic authentication.

flags.name: -c
flags.description: <config_file> Configuration file. Other arguments can be used as well, overriding config file settings.

flags.name: -D
flags.description: <address>[/<net>] ACL deny rule. Syntax same as -A.

flags.name: -d
flags.description: <domain> Domain/workgroup can be set separately.

flags.name: -F
flags.description: <flags> NTLM authentication flags.

flags.name: -f
flags.description: Run in foreground, do not fork into daemon mode.

flags.name: -G
flags.description: <pattern> User-Agent matching for the trans-isa-scan plugin.

flags.name: -g
flags.description: Gateway mode - listen on all interfaces, not only loopback.

flags.name: -H
flags.description: Print password hashes for use in config file (NTLMv2 needs -u and -d).

flags.name: -h
flags.description: Print this help info along with version number.

flags.name: -I
flags.description: Prompt for the password interactively.

flags.name: -L
flags.description: [<saddr>:]<lport>:<rhost>:<rport> Forwarding/tunneling a la OpenSSH. Same syntax - listen on lport and forward all connections through the proxy to rhost:rport. Can be used for direct tunneling without corkscrew, etc.

flags.name: -l
flags.description: [<saddr>:]<lport> Main listening port for the NTLM proxy.

flags.name: -M
flags.description: <testurl> Magic autodetection of proxy's NTLM dialect.

flags.name: -N
flags.description: "<hostname_wildcard1>[, <hostname_wildcardN>" List of URL's to serve directly as stand-alone proxy (e.g. '*.local')

flags.name: -O
flags.description: [<saddr>:]<lport> Enable SOCKS5 proxy on port lport (binding to address saddr)

flags.name: -P
flags.description: <pidfile> Create a PID file upon successful start.

flags.name: -p
flags.description: <password> Account password. Will not be visible in "ps", /proc, etc.

flags.name: -q
flags.description: Sets the Syslog logging level to DEBUG (default level is INFO).

flags.name: -R
flags.description: <username>:<password> Enable authorization for SOCKS5 proxy, when enabled. It can be used several times, to create a whole list of accounts.

flags.name: -r
flags.description: "HeaderName: value" Add a header substitution. All such headers will be added/replaced in the client's requests.

flags.name: -S
flags.description: <size_in_kb> Enable automation of GFI WebMonitor ISA scanner for files < size_in_kb.

flags.name: -s
flags.description: Do not use threads, serialize all requests - for debugging only.

flags.name: -T
flags.description: <file.log> Redirect all debug information into a trace file for support upload. MUST be the first argument on the command line, implies -v.

flags.name: -U
flags.description: <uid> Run as uid. It is an important security measure not to run as root.

flags.name: -u
flags.description: <user>[@<domain] Domain/workgroup can be set separately.

flags.name: -v
flags.description: Print debugging information.

flags.name: -w
flags.description: <workstation> Some proxies require correct NetBIOS hostname.

flags.name: -x
flags.description: <PAC_file> Specify a PAC file to load.

flags.name: -X
flags.description: <sspi_handle_type> Use SSPI with specified handle type. Works only under Windows. Default is negotiate.
